name: Javelin Flick
description: Flick a short javelin of soul force from the wrist to sting the target's will.

name: Javelin Catch
description: Catch a hostile soul strike on the javelin shaft and turn it away from the mind.

name: Javelin Reckon
description: Hurl a light javelin ahead and reckon the range and strength of the soul it strikes.

name: Matched Javelins
description: Cast two javelins a heartbeat apart so the second lands in the gap the first has made.

name: Javelin Pin
description: Pin the target's will to the ground of the soul with a javelin through its centre.

name: Javelin Fan
description: Spread a fan of small javelins across the field so each foe in front takes one.

name: Javelin Pierce
description: Hurl a heavy javelin that goes through the outer guard and lodges in the target's will.

name: Pair Javelin Cast
description: Gather two great javelins over several breaths and hurl them at once to split a strong guard.

name: Javelin Unmaking
description: Cast a single javelin whose point passes every defence and unmakes a piece of the soul it meets.

name: Twin Lancefall
description: The school's finishing stroke where two soul lances fall in turn on one mark and the second drives through the first.

name: Perch Sense
description: Hold the sense still from a high perch and note every soul that stirs below.

name: Waiting Strike
description: Strike only at the instant the target's guard breaks rhythm and not a heartbeat before.

name: Folded Wing
description: Fold the soul close in on itself like a wing at rest and take a blow on its edge.

name: Circling Sense
description: Circle the foe with the sense and let each pass steady the will for the stroke that is coming.

name: Waiting Talon
description: Hold a talon of force poised above the target so that any rash technique draws a sudden rake.

name: Patient Stoop
description: Fall at last upon a foe grown careless and strike with the whole stored patience of the wait.

name: Hooded Eye
description: Draw a hood over the target's sense so they cannot find the soul that is about to strike.

name: Unhurried Stoop
description: Dive in a calm unhurried line that cannot be dodged because it began long before it fell.

name: Perfect Moment
description: Wait until every part of the will agrees and then let the next stroke carry all of them.

name: Certain Talon
description: Strike with a talon that has already chosen its mark and wounds the soul past any guard.

name: Hawkfall Verdict
description: The school's stroke of long waiting and a single fall that ends the exchange on the first touch.

name: Still Surface
description: Hold the will so still that a hostile soul strike skims off it like a stone off water.

name: Glint Strike
description: Flash a bright glint of soul force into the target's eyes of will and strike behind it.

name: Depth Gaze
description: Look down into a foe's soul as into clear water and see what moves beneath.

name: Reflected Blow
description: Turn a weak soul strike on the surface of the will and send it back at the one who threw it.

name: Rippling Return
description: Answer a blow with a ripple that runs back along its own path and strikes the sender.

name: Mirror Bind
description: Show the target their own will in the mirror and hold them fixed on that image.

name: Surface Throw
description: Catch a strong soul strike on the mirrored will and hurl it back with extra weight.

name: Flowing Return
description: Let the stored reflections flow out in one clean line that goes through the sender's guard.

name: Flawless Mirror
description: Take a heavy soul blow wholly into the still will and loose its whole force back on the sender.

name: Answering Torrent
description: The school's answer where the whole river of a hostile attack is returned over every soul that sent it.

name: Circlet Prick
description: Prick the target's will with a ring of small points set about a single mark.

name: Circlet Ward
description: Raise a bright diadem of will over the head to turn blows aimed at the mind.

name: Coronet Sense
description: Let the ring of the will turn slowly and mark every soul that crosses its rim.

name: Rim Gather
description: Gather force round the rim of the will until it is dense enough for the finishing stroke.

name: Coronet Weave
description: Weave two lines of soul force round the target and close them at the crown of their guard.

name: Circlet Bind
description: Close a ring of force round the target's will and draw it tight until they cannot move it.

name: Coronet Press
description: Set a heavy diadem of force on the target's will and press until they stoop under it.

name: Twin Circlets
description: Cast two rings of force that strike together and cross inside the foe's focus.

name: Crowning Pierce
description: Drive both tracks of force into the crown of the target's will in one piercing stroke.

name: Crowned Sunder
description: Gather the ring over several breaths and bring it down to split a heavy guard of will.

name: Coronation
description: Set the crown of force on a foe's soul and close it so that it wounds the core past any guard.

name: Crowning Verdict
description: The school's last stroke where both tracks meet at the crown and the foe's will is judged and closed.

name: Windborn Vow
description: Speak the vow into the soul's breath so that the next stroke is carried on a rising wind.

name: Oath Gust
description: Loose a short gust of sworn soul force that buffets the target's will.

name: Gust Veil
description: Draw a veil of eddying wind round the mind so a hostile touch loses its footing.

name: Oathbound Squall
description: Send a wide squall of sworn soul force across the field and rattle every will before it.

name: Oath Leash
description: Tether the target's will to the vow so that it cannot go further than the oath allows.

name: Rolling Oath
description: Roll the oath over the target again and again until their will no longer rises against it.

name: Pledge Cyclone
description: Spin the sworn wind into a cyclone that tears at every soul about the user.

name: Sworn Pierce
description: Gather the vow into a single point over several breaths and send it through a guard.

name: Vow Fulfilled
description: Complete the oath with a stroke whose weight is every promise kept and which wounds past guard.

name: Windsworn Fall
description: The school's fall of the whole sworn wind on one will so it is pierced and held in the same breath.

name: Bearing Prick
description: Prick a soul along a fixed bearing with a thin thread of force that does not bend.

name: Distance Hold
description: Keep a still guard at the user's front that blunts any line of force run in from afar.

name: Bearing Gauge
description: Gauge the bearing and the range to a distant soul by the pull of the thread.

name: Straining Cord
description: Draw the line of force taut to the target and let its weight press their will down.

name: Cracking Lash
description: Snap the taut line like a whip so the end lashes across a distant soul.

name: Far Tether
description: Tether a distant foe's will to the user's line so they cannot withdraw it.

name: Running Bearing
description: Run the line from soul to soul in order so each foe takes a stroke in turn.

name: Distant Rend
description: Rend the guard of a far soul with a long line gathered over several breaths.

name: Unwavering Seal
description: Hold the line unbroken to a distant foe and seal their will against any technique.

name: Far Verdict
description: Send the whole bearing at the farthest soul in reach and wound it beneath every guard.

name: Farthest Bearing
description: The school's stroke along the longest bearing that pierces the foe's soul and seals it in one line.

name: Sky Breath
description: Breathe the open air through the mind and feel the force of the next stroke widen.

name: Open Strike
description: Strike from a mind left wide open so the blow carries no hesitation and no cover.

name: Cloudless Ward
description: Keep the mind clear of cloud so no hidden fear is left for a hostile soul to seize.

name: Cloudless Sweep
description: Sweep clean open force across the field and strip the haze from every mind it passes.

name: Wide Sight
description: Let the sense open to the horizon of the mind and mark every soul in a great ring.

name: Unclouded Thought
description: Show the target a perfectly clear thought and break their own muddle against it.

name: Skyward Cut
description: Cut upward through the guard in a single clean line that rises and does not stop.

name: Overcast Pressing
description: Draw a heavy overcast down on the target's will until it can no longer lift.

name: Open Heaven
description: Open the mind to its full breadth and strike so that the whole sky of force falls on one soul.

name: Skybound Reckoning
description: The school's reckoning where the open mind strips every guard before it and bears the will beneath it down.

name: Oath Whisper
description: Whisper the vow into the target's will with a soft stroke that stings like a sworn word.

name: Crest Ward
description: Raise a crest of wind about the soul that parts a hostile strike over the top.

name: Draught Sense
description: Keep a quiet watch on the wind that moves through every soul in range.

name: Vow Breath
description: Breathe the vow out slowly and let the held breath add its weight to the next stroke.

name: Sworn Eddy
description: Spin a small sworn eddy in the target's focus and tear their concentration into loose strands.

name: Crown Gust
description: Bring a crowned gust down on the head of the target's will with heavy weight.

name: Tether Oath
description: Bind the target's will with a spoken oath that tightens each time they try to stray.

name: Rolling Edict
description: Roll a stern command across the target's will until it ceases to answer any other voice.

name: Edict of Wind
description: Pronounce an edict of the wind that bows the target's will and holds it there for a time.

name: Heaven Gust
description: Call down a vast gust upon the field that bends every will within it.

name: Sovereign Breeze
description: Let a single sovereign breeze pass through a soul and wound its core beneath all guard.

name: Windcrown Edict
description: The school's last command where the crowned wind speaks one edict that the foe's whole will must obey.
